hooks.command:
node -e "console.log('This project uses beads (bd) for persistent task tracking across sessions.

Quick Commands:
- /bd-ready  Show unblocked tasks ready to work on
- /bd-work <id>  Claim and start a task
- /bd-complete <id>  Finish task and find next work
- /bd-plan  Create implementation plan with bd issues

Run: bd ready --json to check for previous work.
Check .claude-sessions/ for recent session files.')"

SessionStart.description: Initialize session with bd context and check for previous work

hooks.command: node -e "console.error('[Hook] Context compaction starting. Save critical state: bd update <id> --notes and create session file in .claude-sessions/')"

PreCompact.description: Remind to save critical state before context compaction

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.command||'';if(/(npm run dev|pnpm( run)? dev|yarn dev|bun run dev|python -m http|flask run|uvicorn)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"<command>\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev');process.exit(2)}}catch(e){}})"

PreToolUse.description: Block dev servers outside tmux - ensures log access

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.command||'';if(/git push/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Review changes before push...')}}catch(e){}})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.file_path||'';if(/\.(md|txt)$/.test(p)&&!/(README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING)\.md$/.test(p)&&!p.includes('.claude-sessions/')){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file: '+p);console.error('[Hook] Use README.md or .claude-sessions/ for docs');process.exit(2)}}catch(e){}})"

PreToolUse.description: Block random .md files except README and session files

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.command||'';if(/bd close/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Task closed! Run /bd-ready to see newly unblocked tasks')}else if(/bd create.*--parent/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Task created under epic. Set dependencies with bd dep add if needed')}else if(/(npm test|pnpm test|yarn test|pytest|go test|cargo test)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Tests complete. Update bd task with results: bd update <id> --notes')}else if(/gh pr create/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] PR created! Close related bd tasks: bd close <id> -m Merged')}}catch(e){}})"

PostToolUse.description: Context tips after bd operations, tests, and PRs

hooks.command: node -e "console.error('[Hook] Session ending. Checklist: 1) Update bd tasks with notes 2) Close completed tasks 3) Save session to .claude-sessions/ 4) Run bd sync and git push')"

Stop.description: Session end checklist for memory persistence
